title.en: Read the coordinates of a point in space
Identify the octant from the signs of the coordinates

say.en: A drone hovering 5 metres east, 3 metres north and 10 metres above its launch pad sits at the point (5, 3, 10). In this lesson: Read the coordinates of a point in space.
Identify the octant from the signs of the coordinates.

body.en: Through a *point* P draw three planes parallel to the coordinate planes, meeting the x-, y- and z-axes at A, B and C. If OA = x, OB = y and OC = z (with signs), P is the point $(x, y, z)$. So $x$ is the signed distance of P from the YZ-plane, $y$ from the ZX-plane and $z$ from the XY-plane.
body.kn: x ನಿರ್ದೇಶಾಂಕ ಎಂದರೆ YZ-ಸಮತಲದಿಂದ ಬಿಂದುವಿನ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಸಹಿತ ದೂರ; y ಎಂದರೆ ZX-ಸಮತಲದಿಂದ, z ಎಂದರೆ XY-ಸಮತಲದಿಂದ ದೂರ.

narration.en: The x coordinate is the signed distance of the point from the YZ plane, y from the ZX plane, and z from the XY plane.
narration.kn: x ನಿರ್ದೇಶಾಂಕ ಎಂದರೆ YZ-ಸಮತಲದಿಂದ ಬಿಂದುವಿನ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಸಹಿತ ದೂರ; y ಎಂದರೆ ZX-ಸಮತಲದಿಂದ, z ಎಂದರೆ XY-ಸಮತಲದಿಂದ ದೂರ.

say.en: The x coordinate is the signed distance of the point from the YZ plane, y from the ZX plane, and z from the XY plane. Distance from YZ-plane = |x|.
say.kn: x ನಿರ್ದೇಶಾಂಕ ಎಂದರೆ YZ-ಸಮತಲದಿಂದ ಬಿಂದುವಿನ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಸಹಿತ ದೂರ; y ಎಂದರೆ ZX-ಸಮತಲದಿಂದ, z ಎಂದರೆ XY-ಸಮತಲದಿಂದ ದೂರ.

say.en: Distance from ZX-plane = |y|.
Distance from XY-plane = |z|.

narration.en: To reach P(2, 3, 4) from O, walk 2 along the x-axis, then 3 parallel to the y-axis, then climb 4 parallel to the z-axis.

say.en: To reach P(2, 3, 4) from O, walk 2 along the x-axis, then 3 parallel to the y-axis, then climb 4 parallel to the z-axis.
The point B, where we stopped before climbing, is the foot of the perpendicular from P to the XY-plane: (2, 3, 0).
The signs of the coordinates tell us the octant. Octant one has all three positive; octant seven has all three negative.
So minus 3, 1, minus 2 has signs minus, plus, minus: octant six. And 4, minus 2, minus 5 is in octant eight.
To reach P(2, 3, 4) from O, walk 2 along the x-axis, then 3 parallel to the y-axis, then climb 4 parallel to the z-axis.

title.en: Walk to the point (x, y, z)

body.en: Octant I: $(+, +, +)$; II: $(-, +, +)$; III: $(-, -, +)$; IV: $(+, -, +)$; V: $(+, +, -)$; VI: $(-, +, -)$; VII: $(-, -, -)$; VIII: $(+, -, -)$. The first four lie above the XY-plane ($z > 0$) and the last four below it.
body.kn: ಅಷ್ಟಕ I ರಿಂದ IV ರಲ್ಲಿ z ಧನ, ಅವು ಚತುರ್ಥಕಗಳ ಕ್ರಮವನ್ನೇ ಅನುಸರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. V ರಿಂದ VIII ರಲ್ಲಿ ಅದೇ ಕ್ರಮ, ಆದರೆ z ಋಣ.

narration.en: Octants one to four have z positive and follow the order of the four quadrants. Octants five to eight repeat that order with z negative.
narration.kn: ಅಷ್ಟಕ I ರಿಂದ IV ರಲ್ಲಿ z ಧನ, ಅವು ಚತುರ್ಥಕಗಳ ಕ್ರಮವನ್ನೇ ಅನುಸರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. V ರಿಂದ VIII ರಲ್ಲಿ ಅದೇ ಕ್ರಮ, ಆದರೆ z ಋಣ.

problem.en: In which octants do (−3, 1, 2), (4, −2, −5) and (−1, −2, −3) lie?

narration.en: Let us solve this together. In which octants do (−3, 1, 2), (4, −2, −5) and (−1, −2, −3) lie?

say.en: Let us solve this together. In which octants do (minus 3, 1, 2), (4, minus 2, minus 5) and (minus 1, minus 2, minus 3) lie?
(minus 3, 1, 2): signs (-, plus, plus): octant II.
(4, minus 2, minus 5): signs (plus, minus, -): octant VIII.
(minus 1, minus 2, minus 3): signs (-, minus, -): octant VII.
So the answer is II, VIII, VII.

problem.en: Find the distances of P(3, −4, 5) from the three coordinate planes and from the x-axis.

steps.en: From the YZ-plane |x| = 3, from the ZX-plane |y| = 4, from the XY-plane |z| = 5.
The foot of the perpendicular on the x-axis is (3, 0, 0).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the distances of P(3, −4, 5) from the three coordinate planes and from the x-axis.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find the distances of P(3, minus 4, 5) from the three coordinate planes and from the x-axis.
From the YZ-plane |x| = 3, from the ZX-plane |y| = 4, from the XY-plane |z| = 5.
The foot of the perpendicular on the x-axis is (3, 0, 0).
Distance from the x-axis equals the square root of 4 squared plus 5 squared equals the square root of 41.
So the answer is 3, 4, 5 and the square root of 41.

body.en: Ignore z and find the quadrant of (x, y): that is the octant number if z > 0. If z < 0, add 4. So (−2, −3, −1) is quadrant III, plus 4: octant VII.

narration.en: Octants copy the quadrants. Ignore z and find the quadrant of (x, y): that is the octant number if z > 0. If z < 0, add 4. So (−2, −3, −1) is quadrant III, plus 4: octant VII.

mnemonic.en: Quadrant number, plus 4 if z is negative

say.en: Octants copy the quadrants. Ignore z and find the quadrant of (x, y): that is the octant number if z is greater than 0. If z is less than 0, add 4. So (minus 2, minus 3, minus 1) is quadrant III, plus 4: octant VII.
